name: @pipeworx/mcp-datacommons

tools.name: datacommons_find_place
tools.description: Find the Google Data Commons place id (dcid) for a place name — country, state, county, city, region. Returns candidates with name and place type, e.g. "California" -> geoId/06, "India" -> country/IND. Use the dcid with datacommons_observation or datacommons_child_places. Narrow ambiguous names (Paris, Georgia) with place_type.

_apiKey.description: Data Commons API key (free). Get one at https://apikeys.datacommons.org

place_type.description: Restrict to one place type, e.g. Country, State, County, City, AdministrativeArea1, EurostatNUTS2

tools.name: datacommons_find_variable
tools.description: Search Google Data Commons statistical variables by plain-language indicator, e.g. "median household income" -> Median_Income_Household, "unemployment rate" -> UnemploymentRate_Person. Returns variable ids with names and a match score. Use the id as `variable` in datacommons_observation.

_apiKey.description: Data Commons API key (free). Get one at https://apikeys.datacommons.org

query.description: What you want to measure, e.g. "life expectancy", "CO2 emissions per capita"

tools.name: datacommons_observation
tools.description: Get the value of one Google Data Commons statistical variable for one place: the latest value (default), the value at a date, or the whole time series. Each value names its original publisher (US Census, World Bank, Eurostat, CDC, ...) and lists how alternate sources differ. Example: variable "Count_Person", place "country/USA".

_apiKey.description: Data Commons API key (free). Get one at https://apikeys.datacommons.org

variable.description: Statistical variable dcid, e.g. Count_Person, Median_Income_Household (find with datacommons_find_variable)

place.description: Place dcid, e.g. country/USA, geoId/06, Earth (find with datacommons_find_place)

date.description: LATEST (default), all (full series), or a date: 2019, 2019-06, 2019-06-30

limit.description: With date=all, max observations returned, most recent kept (default 50, max 500)

tools.name: datacommons_child_places
tools.description: Compare one Google Data Commons statistical variable across every child place of a parent — e.g. population of all US states, median income of every county in Texas (geoId/48, County), GDP of every country in Europe. Returns rows sorted by value with names and the publisher of each value.

_apiKey.description: Data Commons API key (free). Get one at https://apikeys.datacommons.org

parent_place.description: Parent place dcid, e.g. country/USA, geoId/48, europe, Earth

child_type.description: Child place type, e.g. State, County, City, Country

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-datacommons forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the datacommons pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
